_comment: The properties you own, the competitors you measure against, and the topics
you want to win. This file is the only thing that changes when you add a
domain — every script reads it, so the 11th property is a config entry.
role: owned      audited, researched, gets a target list and generated assets
role: benchmark  audited with the identical checks so gaps are measured
rather than assumed. Never gets a target list — we don't
write content for someone else's site.
Everything here is public. No credentials, no logged-in sessions.

properties.name: 8x Social
properties.notes: Two-sided marketplace. Brands are demand, creators are supply. 8x's own careers page names Brazil, Turkey, Mexico, Germany and Spain as priority launch markets, so those are the markets configured here.

properties.name: 8x Creator App
properties.notes: The creator-facing product. Included because a product surface that search engines can reach is part of the portfolio's health, even if it isn't a content property.

properties.name: 8x Careers
properties.notes: Careers site, linked from the 8x.social footer. Its robots.txt returns HTML rather than plain text, which the audit flags.

properties.name: SideShift
properties.notes: Named as a competitor in 8x's own SEO notes.

properties.name: Shortimize
properties.notes: The tool-portfolio reference from the brief. Scored with the same checks so the pattern is measured, not assumed.

properties.name: Social Growth Engineers
properties.notes: Competitor 8x's CTO described as a blog-post powerhouse.

_adding_a_property: Copy a block, change the values, run:
It audits every property, researches keywords for the owned ones, saves a
dated snapshot, diffs against the last run, and rebuilds the dashboard.
